parsed.narrative_sentence: Led regulated-financial-services modernization by translating complex quantitative risk and capital requirements into traceable, governed operating models that strengthened decision support, model oversight, and enterprise execution.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.

Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.
